Ouyang Nana stands against a muted backdrop, dressed in a white long-sleeved dress featuring a contrasting black collar and intricate lace-trimmed cuffs. Her dark, glossy hair falls over one shoulder as she gently holds a pale yellow daisy, her soft gaze conveying a calm, poised presence.

source.description:
Ouyang Nana in Floral Portrait

Ouyang Nana appears against a vibrant backdrop of mixed flowers, gently holding white blossoms in her hands. Her dark, wavy hair falls softly around her shoulders, complementing the black straps of her dress and drawing attention to her clear, expressive eyes. The pastel hues of the flowers and the warm lighting create a serene, springlike atmosphere.

Born on June 15, 2000, in Taipei City, Taiwan, Ouyang Nana is a classically trained cellist, actress, and singer who graduated from the Berklee College of Music. She made her film debut in Beijing Love Story (2014) and released the award-winning album 15 in 2015.

source.description:
Ouyang Nana’s Garden Portrait

Ouyang Nana, the 19‑year‑old Taiwanese actress and cellist, stands poised in a fitted white top against a lattice covered in red blossoms and green leaves. Her serene expression and minimalist styling contrast with the lush floral backdrop, creating a fresh yet mature visual.

This portrait was taken around the time she guested on the mainland beauty program “Beauty小姐.” Online commentators noted that her sophisticated outfit made her appear older than 35‑year‑old actress Qi Wei, sparking discussions about age‑appropriate styling and youthful image.
